revisions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL detailed chibi wuxia pixel-art GAMEPLAY sprites. Fixed elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter RPG camera, square-aligned ground, NOT isometric, side-scroller, 3D, portrait painting or blurry illustration. Crisp pixel clusters, warm dark outlines, upper-left light. Real differently drawn articulated poses, never translated/scaled duplicates. Transparent alpha, NO checkerboard, shadows, labels, borders, gridlines or text. Evenly spaced invisible cells, ALL artwork inside own cell with generous transparent padding. Camera never rotates. Asset: Hoàn Nhan Hồng Liệt boss locomotion prototype. Match attached boss concept's identity ONLY: stern middle-aged black moustache/beard, black iron lamellar armor with ornate bronze-gold trim and small orange molten cracks, cream fur collar, crimson long cape, helmet with crimson plume, ONE huge curved dark dao with magma fissures held consistently in RIGHT HAND. Compact chibi strong body, not tall realistic proportions. Target body64px relative hero44px after later mechanical export. EXACT 1536x1024 sheet,6columns4rows,24 cels. Row0 DOWN/front, row1 LEFT, row2 RIGHT, row3 UP/back (cape visible, face hidden). ALL six cells in each row stay in that facing. Columns: idle breathA, idle breathB, walk left contact, walk passA, walk right contact, walk passB. Stable feet at80%cellheight, stable center/scale, natural alternating steps, cloth/plume motion and arm articulation. Weapon must fit every cell, NO fiery aura around body. This is a clean animation source sheet, NOT the parchment concept.

Use case: background-extraction. EDIT TARGET attached 24-cel boss locomotion sprite sheet. Remove ALL brown/parchment/gradient background pixels and make them genuinely alpha=0 transparent, including the spaces around and between each character and between weapon/cape and legs. Preserve ALL 24 boss character silhouettes, poses, costumes, weapons, original arrangement, exact1536x1024 canvas,6columns4rows, pixel details/colors/scale. NO replacement background, checkerboard, floor, gray fringe, gradient, rectangular halo or shadow. Output a clean transparent sprite sheet suitable for compositing directly on an arbitrary dark/bright RPG floor. Background is unwanted; all brown squares must disappear. Every non-character pixel must alpha0.
revisions.note: Alpha checked on contrasting background; retain initial source too.

assets.description: EIGHT successive cels left-to-right top row then bottom row: 1 thin amber broken circular ground warning perimeter, 2 warning cracks brighten inward,3 first basalt chips lift,4 concentrated stomp shock center,5 HUGE wide outward elliptical lava/stone shockwave with empty readable center,6 shockwave expands into broken rugged rim,7 embers/dust dissipate,8 cooling scattered pebbles. This is an around-boss stomp STUN cue, not a tall volcano. Ground plane at fixed elevated view, flattened broad ellipse, blast low enough to preserve characters. Palette amber warning vs molten orange hit vs cool gray ash expiry.

ONE volcano in each cell, consistent ground anchor at65% cellheight; flame may rise above. Volcanic rock physically rises from ground, NOT meteor falling, not generic fireball. Empty ground around each asset for scene compositing.

Must be a STRAIGHT broad rectangular-ish ground lane, NOT circular fire ring, not crescent slash, not isolated explosions. All cels same footprint4:1 ground length/width; maintain constant cool ash outer edge to read against brown ground. The looping sustained hazard is frames5-7.
